intent: Report the cat ownership rate among American households from the data table.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the cat ownership rate among American households as a gauge value.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: The cat ownership rate among American households is 30.4%.

optional_valid: Displaying the complement (69.6% non-owners) as an inferred remainder is optional and not required by the intent.
unsupported_to_avoid: Reporting an absolute count of cat-owning households.
Comparing cat ownership to other pet types not present in the table.
Treating the gauge as a full composition with multiple named sectors.
review_notes: The intent asks only for the cat ownership rate, so a single gauge_value unit is sufficient.
The partial ring/gauge should encode 30.4% of a full circle.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
